findings.summary: The new detailed-event layout supplies address, exact hours, explicit dates, exception, organizer and GPS; the operational reader rejects this format. Correspondence to a legacy catalog market still needs a proved join.
A current provincial layout is obtainable from an existing town URL, but the scheduler admits only province URLs already represented in the catalog.
52 source rows versus 8 Happings TS records show why discovery must retain venue identity; this does not prove 44 new independent markets after cross-source deduplication.
Avellino has 110 rows and Bari 46, but no specific street passes the current parser. Repeated extraction cannot turn centro into a precise address.
The page titled Milano e provincia includes municipalities now assigned to MB. Publisher page title cannot update administrative geography.
One real lossy-accent URL returned HTTP 404. That sample has no observed HTML or field absence claims.

todos.title: Add an event-detail field reader and prove each join
todos.mechanism_change: Discover current event-detail links under a bounded source budget, then join by compatible full identity, municipality, weekday and venue evidence. Extract only fields scoped to that event; keep primary IDs and existing human facts.
acceptance_tests: Fixture returns address, ordinary hours, explicit dates, organizer profile and source GPS for the self Event URL.
Related-event cards, footer/publisher Organization and a second market in the same town cannot contribute fields.
Ambiguous venue/name matches produce review evidence without overwriting an existing address or claiming precise GPS.

todos.title: Preserve explicit calendars and edition exceptions
todos.mechanism_change: Read the bounded list of editions and attach exceptions to their edition. Keep source-reported dates distinct from forecasts and confirmations; an Event JSON-LD next-date object cannot establish all recurrences.
acceptance_tests: Nine ordinary Friday entries plus the listed Thursday exception remain ten dates, without fabricating 25 December or January dates.
The extraordinary 24 December closing time remains 13:00; do not copy the next-date 12:30 end time to it.
A missing next edition, changed boundary or conflicting text/JSON-LD prevents renewal until the scope is resolved.

todos.title: Discover current province resources even when none was stored
todos.mechanism_change: Use a bounded resolver for legacy town URLs and independently validate observed destination/canonical geography before admitting the current provincial resource. Do not require an already-saved provincial URL as the only source of discovery.
acceptance_tests: The Trieste-shaped fixture becomes a source resource candidate while all 8 old TS market IDs remain intact.
A canonical link or redirect to a different/unproved province fails closed; no inferred HTTP redirect metadata.
Source-location ambiguity is still held after routing succeeds.

todos.title: Retain distinct venue rows when discovering or reconciling a town
todos.mechanism_change: Keep separate source row identities for town + weekday + venue before any market-level deduplication or import. Review unmatched venues as source candidates instead of choosing the first venue for every town/day.
acceptance_tests: The 52-row Trieste-shaped source fixture retains all 52 row identities; a seven-weekday map cannot collapse them to 7.
Multiple venues on the same weekday never yield an arbitrary address overwrite.
Cross-source duplicate review occurs before declaring a new market; source rows are not counted as newly verified markets.

todos.title: Resolve lossy legacy URL variants with evidence
todos.mechanism_change: Queue a 404 legacy link as an unavailable source and use observed publisher links or trusted discovery to find a candidate. Preserve the original URL and do not reconstruct missing accented letters or strip identifying numeric suffixes as an automatic join.
acceptance_tests: A 404 sample contributes no field-presence claims or freshness receipt.
A guessed town slug is never recorded as an observed canonical or redirect.
Repeated-hyphen, suffix-number and qualifier variants remain distinct until a source/identity match is proven.

todos.title: Represent temporal qualifiers separately from municipality names
todos.mechanism_change: Parse unambiguous source qualifiers into a separate retained calendar scope while preserving the original label. Maintain quarantine whenever the complete season or fortnightly anchor is absent.
acceptance_tests: Estivo does not create a year-round weekly forecast or get swallowed into a geographical match.
Ogni 15gg without an anchor cannot turn into a weekly or an invented fortnightly calendar.
Known place names such as Inverno e Monteleone or Passeggiata d’Inverno remain protected from false seasonal matches.

todos.title: Report missing fields according to what each source format supplies
todos.mechanism_change: Maintain separate counts for field present and parsed, present but unsupported/lost, absent in the sampled source, and unresolved identity. Preserve dayparts as qualitative information only if the model can label them honestly.
acceptance_tests: A source giving only centro contributes zero recoverable precise addresses.
La mattina remains a daypart and never becomes fabricated opening/closing hours.
An event-detail page with real hours is counted as an unsupported field-reader gap rather than source-hours absent.

todos.title: Keep publisher page dates as separately scoped evidence
todos.mechanism_change: Record observed article/WebPage publication and modification dates for page provenance. Preserve their scope and do not substitute a read date, import date, generic website metadata or migration date for market verification.
acceptance_tests: JSON-LD WebPage.datePublished is discoverable even when article meta tags are absent.
A page publication date cannot manufacture event confirmation or override a contradicted edition list.
Unknown row freshness remains distinguishable from a known page publication date.

limitations: The original pre-migration town-page HTML was not available; current returned content cannot prove every field existed when the legacy importer ran.
Seven successful HTML samples establish observed templates and concrete gaps; this is not a claim that all 3,329 distinct Happings URLs were read.
Canonical URLs observed in HTML are kept separate from unobserved HTTP redirects.
Source assertions and source-provided GPS are not independent validation of market operation or map precision.
